segments.name: Ghana
segments.description: Produces oil and gas from the Jubilee and TEN fields offshore Ghana for crude oil and gas buyers.
segments.evidence: In Ghana, we plan to maintain a consistent drilling program, bringing additional development wells online at the Jubilee Field in the near term, supported by high facility uptime and sustained water injection.

segments.name: Equatorial Guinea
segments.description: Produces oil and gas from the Ceiba Field and Okume Complex offshore Equatorial Guinea for marketing agents and purchasers.
segments.evidence: In October 2025, we submitted a formal notice to the Ministry of Hydrocarbons and Mining Development that we are electing to exit Block S offshore Equatorial Guinea.

segments.name: Mauritania | Senegal
segments.description: Develops and produces natural gas and LNG offshore Mauritania and Senegal for gas and LNG buyers.
segments.evidence: Offshore Mauritania and Senegal, growth is expected to be realized through additional development beyond GTA Phase 1 by fully utilizing the existing infrastructure.

segments.name: Gulf of America
segments.description: Produces oil and gas from deepwater fields in the Gulf of America through subsea tie-backs to existing host facilities.
segments.evidence: Most recently, we have demonstrated infrastructure-led exploration success through the Winterfell and Tiberius discoveries in the Gulf of America in 2021 and 2023, respectively.

revenueModel.text: Oil and gas marketing agents and customers pay for crude oil and natural gas sold from our producing fields under sales agreements.
revenueModel.evidence: For our Gulf of America operations, crude oil and natural gas are transported to customers using third-party pipelines.

changes.text: In 2025 the company elected to exit Block S offshore Equatorial Guinea.
changes.evidence: In October 2025, we submitted a formal notice to the Ministry of Hydrocarbons and Mining Development that we are electing to exit Block S offshore Equatorial Guinea.

changes.text: In 2024 the company elected to exit another block offshore Equatorial Guinea.
changes.evidence: In December 2024, we submitted a formal notice to the Ministry of Hydrocarbons and Mining Development that we are electing to exit Block 21 offshore Equatorial Guinea.

changes.text: In 2026 the company agreed to sell its Ceiba Field and Okume Complex production assets in Block G offshore Equatorial Guinea.
changes.evidence: On February 24, 2026, we entered into a Share Sale and Purchase Agreement with a subsidiary of Panoro Energy ASA for the sale of all of our participating interest in the Ceiba Field and Okume Complex production assets located in Block G offshore Equatorial Guinea
